articles.detail: 5 scheduled cycles; only 04:03 and 22:03 deployed — the 08:00/12:04/17:00 batches were written and validated but held on disk by a build failure, then all shipped together at 22:03

experiment: Skipped — the noNewExperimentsUntil gate runs to 2026-08-26, and no experiments are active. Every published metric is inside target anyway.
weakestArea: No published metric is the weakest area today — freshness, diversity, multi-source and sci-tech all clear their targets comfortably. The real weakness is delivery reliability: three of five cycles built nothing. A Wikidata concept label carrying literal quotes (Ecologist Party "The Greens") was interpolated raw into a double-quoted YAML scalar, so js-yaml rejected the frontmatter, build.js died, and because the article was never committed it poisoned the 08:00, 12:04 and 17:00 builds in turn. Fixed and committed today in c76ef122 (six unescaped interpolation sites routed through yamlStr, plus a real parse in validate-articles.js that quarantines to .bad instead of string-matching); the 22:03 cycle deployed clean and all 8,508 articles now parse.
watching: Iran plans to charge transiting ships at Hormuz while simultaneously seeking de-escalation with Egypt — two Tehran datelines pulling opposite directions in one day.
Congo's Ebola outbreak is accelerating; case-count follow-ups will need consistent sourcing rather than one-off science picks.
China's fourth carrier surfacing at Dalian alongside a delayed crewed Moon landing and a lunar-ice target — a coherent capability story spread across three articles.
Pakistan military diplomacy is clustering (Munir in Tehran, intelligence chief in Bahrain) without a piece tying the tour together.
OAuth stability: 2026-08-23 was the first day since 08-19 with zero 'session expired' failures. Two more clean days are needed before the experiment gate lifts on 08-26.
coverageGaps: Latin America is entirely absent — all 8 Americas datelines are US or Canadian (Washington, New York, Baltimore, Reno, Ottawa, Skidegate). No Brazil, Mexico, Argentina or Andean coverage at all.
Oceania is a single article (One Nation's migration math, Canberra); no Pacific-island, New Zealand or Australian non-political coverage.
Nature supplied 9 of 61 articles and 7 of 13 science pieces — under the 20% share cap, but science depth rests on one outlet.
Southeast Asia is thin: Singapore and one Philippine byline, nothing from Indonesia, Vietnam or Thailand despite 15 Asia datelines.
context: The 08-19 to 08-22 OAuth outage that motivated the current experiment gate has cleared — today's five cycles all authenticated and ran end to end. It was immediately replaced by a different single-point failure: one malformed frontmatter file silently blocking three consecutive deploys, which is why 61 articles landed in two batches instead of five. Both the escaping bug and the validator gap that let it through are fixed, so the gate's remaining purpose is simply to accumulate clean baseline days before a new variable is introduced. Nothing in the tunable-parameter set needs moving; leave the gate at 2026-08-26 and re-assess then.
